chapter.heading: Praise to the Lord for His Holiness
chapter.v:
The Lord
reigns;Let the peoples tremble!He dwells between the cherubim;Let the earth be moved!

The Lord
is great in Zion,And He is high above all the peoples. [Rom. 4:1-3; Heb. 11:11 c Gen. 12:1 d Gen. 24:35; Deut. 1:10; Ezek.]

Let them
praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy. [Is. 40:1; 52:9; Ps. 102:13 f Gen. 13:10; Joel 2:3]

The King’s
strength also loves justice;You have established equity;You have executed justice and righteousness in Jacob. [Is. 2:3] [Is. 42:6]

Exalt the
Lord our God,And worship at His footstool—He is holy. [Is. 46:13 j Ps. 67:4 k Is. 60:9 l [Rom. 1:16]]

Moses and
Aaron were among His priests,And Samuel was among those who called upon His name;They called upon the Lord, and He answered them. [Is. 40:26 n Ps. 102:25, 26; Is. 13:13; 34:4; Matt. 24:35; Heb. 1:10- 12; 2 Pet. 3:10 o Is. Heb. 1:10-12 p Is.]

He spoke
to them in the cloudy pillar;They kept His testimonies and the ordinance He gave them. [Is. 25:8; 54:4; [Matt. 5:11, 12; 10:28; Acts 5:41]] [Ps. 37:31; Jer. 31:33; [Heb. 10:16]]

You answered
them, O Lord our God;You were to them God-Who-Forgives,Though You took vengeance on their deeds. [Is. 50:9]

Exalt the
Lord our God,And worship at His holy hill;For the Lord our God is holy. [Job 26:12; Ps. 89:10; Is. 30:7 x Ps. 87:4 y Ps. 74:13; Is. 27:1] [Ps. 44:23 u Ps. 93:1 v Ps. 44:1]
